pages.title: Opening the Guide
pages.text: By default, your first visit brings this guide and New Journey. If inventory is full, look nearby. Right-click the air to read it. It is not reissued on respawn or rejoining.
Combine a book and an Ice and Fire manuscript in any arrangement.

pages.title: What to Bring
pages.text: Bring a name tag, books, and your companion's favorite food. Books, manuscripts, and bottles o' enchanting are for learning; dragon meal is food.$(br2)Use bone, a name tag, and scales to craft a Guardian Tag. Equip it under $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/companions)Dragon Equipment$(/l).

pages.title: If No Book Arrives
pages.text: The first-entry gift can be disabled in global settings. New Journey and the guide recipe remain available.$(br2)If no book arrives, craft one from a book and an Ice and Fire manuscript. Rejoining or respawning does not reissue it.
